title: 第898章 神域倒悬原来如此第897章 王座之力自身法则
slug: 魔门送葬开局被女帝逆推
lines: “真特么逆天…”
极寒神王等人瞳孔骤缩，等反应过来后，他们方才是明白宁尘刚刚究竟是在做什么，这简直是一场豪赌，简直是个疯子！
若是自身王座承受不住这股六股力量，不仅所掌握的力量将要消散，就连自身都要遭到反噬，甚至连王座都会崩碎！
“不愧是宁小子啊…”
洛青霄等人也是回过神来，感叹不已。
“将将就就，马马虎虎。”
那一袭红裙，容颜绝美的倩影看到这一幕，也是拍了拍那饱满的胸脯，稍稍松了口气。
此刻。
当六道天地法则化作自身的王座之力嵌入王座之中时，宁尘的气息也是在这时节节攀升，最终便是停在了神王境巅峰！
这并非伪巅峰。
而是真正的神王级九星巅峰，距离神祖也仅仅只是一步之遥！
而这才是他这两月内闭关修炼真正的成果！
这两月内除了自身境界只是勉强达到神王境九星以外，宁尘便是将六道法则尽数掌握，为的便是将其化作自身的王座之力！
唯有这样…
方可让自身在短时间内达到真正的神王境的巅峰！
而有了巅峰之力，纵使是如今的寂灭神王，他也有一战之力！
“现在…”
“我们之间的战斗，才是真正的开始。”
宁尘深吸一口气，大手一挥，从储物戒中取出自家娘子那巩固气息的茶水之后，吨吨吨痛饮之后，方才是一只手猛然间抬起。
霎时间。
那已是转化为自身力量的法则之力尽数涌现。
空间扭曲，落在那寂灭神王所落下的毁灭一掌之上。
瞬间。
两股力量重重相撞。
只不过，这一刻宁尘并没有像刚刚一般身形倒飞，狼狈不堪。
这一次，伴随力量爆发，他的身形未动，只是衣角稍稍飘动了一下。
看到这一幕，寂灭神王明显是愣了一下，眼中也不由闪过一抹错愕之色，似是完全没有想到宁尘竟还有如此手段。
“倒是本神王小瞧你了。”
“不过…”
“也仅此而已了！”
寂灭神王话音陡然落下，一脚镇破虚空，混沌之力不断涌现，周身带着寂灭之息，朝着宁尘轰来！
见状。
宁尘冷哼一声，丝毫不虚，神王之威尽数运转，便是抬手攻去。
轰…
content_en:
"It's so outrageous..."
The pupils of the Extreme Cold God King and others shrank suddenly. After reacting, they finally understood what Ning Chen was doing just now. This was a huge gamble and he was a madman!
If your own throne cannot withstand these six forces, not only will the power you control will dissipate, but you will also suffer backlash, and even the throne will collapse!
"As expected of Mr. Ning..."
Luo Qingxiao and others also came to their senses and sighed.
"Hmph!"
"I'll make do with it, just so-so."
Seeing this scene, Qianying, who was wearing a red dress and had a beautiful face, patted her plump breasts and breathed a sigh of relief.
now.
When the Six Laws of Heaven and Earth transformed into the power of the throne and embedded itself into the throne, Ning Chen's aura also climbed steadily at this time, and finally stopped at the peak of the God King Realm!
This is not a false peak.
But the true nine-star peak of the God King level is only one step away from the God Ancestor!
And this is the real result of his two months of retreat and cultivation!
In the past two months, except for the fact that his own realm had barely reached the nine-star level of the God King Realm, Ning Chen had mastered all the laws of the Six Paths in order to turn them into the power of his own throne!
Only this way...
Only then can you reach the peak of the true God King Realm in a short period of time!
And with peak power, even the current God King of Annihilation can still fight!
"Now..."
"The battle between us is the real beginning."
Ning Chen took a deep breath, waved his hand, and took out his wife's aura-strengthening tea from the storage ring. After drinking heavily, he suddenly raised one hand.
All of a sudden.
That is the power of the law that has been transformed into its own power.
The space twisted, falling on the destructive palm dropped by the God King of Annihilation.
boom…!
moment.
The two forces collided heavily.
However, at this moment, Ning Chen did not fly upside down like before and was in a state of embarrassment.
This time, with the explosion of power, his figure did not move, only the corners of his clothes fluttered slightly.
"Huh?"
Seeing this scene, the God King of Annihilation was obviously stunned for a moment, and a look of astonishment flashed in his eyes, as if he had never expected that Ning Chen would have such a method.
"It's true that this God King underestimates you."
"But..."
"That's all!"
The God King of Annihilation's words suddenly fell, and he smashed through the void with one kick. The power of chaos continued to emerge, and with the breath of Annihilation all over his body, he blasted towards Ning Chen!
"Hmph...!"
See this.
Ning Chen snorted coldly, and it was true at all. He used all the power of the God King and raised his hand to attack.
boom…
